decisions.reason: The LED track spotlight line sits close to the firm's core modular lighting offer and has only been on the market one year, so there is no clear shortfall against aspirations that would trigger problemistic search. The firm's product breadth and dealer relationships provide slack to carry it while results firm up.

The LED ceiling luminaire line is a core, low-risk extension of the established range and is still presented prominently. With no evidence of underperformance after one year, management would keep it rather than redirect resources.
